name: Jia Jun Jie
bio:
Jia Jun's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood watching Formula One races with his father. This early fascination led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in precision manufacturing. After graduating, he honed his skills at a local engineering firm, gaining practical experience in CNC machining and materials science. His dedication and eye for detail quickly caught the attention of Tickford Racing, where he now thrives as a key member of the machinist team.

At Tickford Racing, Jia Jun approaches every task with meticulous precision and a relentless pursuit of perfection. He's known for his ability to quickly grasp complex technical drawings and translate them into flawlessly machined components. His flexible attitude and collaborative spirit make him a valuable asset in the fast-paced racing environment. Jia Jun is particularly adept at identifying and resolving machining issues, ensuring that all parts meet the team's exacting standards.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: He has a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a habit of humming quietly while operating machinery.
Keeps a small collection of miniature race cars on his workbench.
